support.description:
Create blend tree logic using a simple user interface rather than connecting animator states!

Type in parameters for Stitch to join together using common logical or mathematical operations. A controller will be created.

Yellow highlights show disallowed values. In mathematical operations, numbers typed in instead of parameters will be used as constants.
Check https://vrc.school/docs/Other/Advanced-BlendTrees (as well as the AAP page) for restrictions.
